Canada is replacing its aging Victoria-class submarines with 12 new vessels from German firm TKMS to bolster maritime sovereignty and meet NATO's 2% GDP defense spending target.

The Bright Side:
This deal provides a reliable, long-term operational capability for a nation with the world's longest coastline.
